spans.s: vithāpita (semi-MIndic ppp., of same derivation and mg. as viṭhapita, see viṭhapayati), illusorily created (Tib. rnam par bsgrubs pa, as regularly for viṭhap˚): māyāraṅgam ivā vithāpitaṃ svamatena LV 〔324.8〕 (vs), like illusory color (or, stage-setting), created by (the fancy of) oneʼs own mind.
